title: Task
description: Which properties a task form shows, requires and accepts is decided by the organization's form settings (see form-settings.schema.json, schemaVersion 3). The limits below are the hard storage limits.

organizationId.description: Unique identifier of the organization to which the task belongs

dueDate.description: Due date (YYYY-MM-DD) or date and time (ISO 8601) depending on the configured component (form key 'dueDate')

priority.description: One of the static option values of the 'priority' component; template: low, medium, high

status.description: One of the static option values of the 'status' component; template: todo, in-progress, completed

tags.description: Tags associated with the task (form key 'tags')

customFields.description: Values of the other form components of the root scope, keyed by the component key (or the path of a group / dynamic list). Empty values are not stored.

updatedAt.description: Last update timestamp (set by the API)

fileReference.description: A file uploaded with POST /api/files (File picker value item). The content is downloaded with GET /api/files/{id}.

value.description: Value of a component. Text / date / time / select values are strings, numbers are numbers, checkboxes booleans, checklists and tag lists lists of strings, file pickers lists of fileReference (1, or up to 10 when 'multiple'), groups with a path objects of child values, dynamic lists lists (max 50) of objects, expressions any JSON value computed in the browser. Hard limits: nesting depth 8, strings 1000 characters, lists 100 items, objects 100 properties.
